Policy.title: Privacy Policy
Policy.intro: This policy describes the data processed when you use Back signal and how to contact us about your personal data.

operator.title: Who processes your data
operator.body: Back signal is operated by Georgy as an individual. For questions about personal data, contact georgyrevazashvili@yandex.ru.

data.title: Data we receive
data.body: When you create an account or sign in: your name, email address, account and session information. When you sign in with Yandex ID: profile data you authorize Yandex to share with us. When you send feedback: your message, selected mood, date and technical information needed to operate and protect the form. You do not need an account to send feedback.

purposes.title: Why we use data
purposes.body: We use this data to provide registration and sign-in, the dashboard, delivery of feedback to the relevant business, service emails and notifications, security, and error resolution. The message text is available to the owner of the relevant feedback page.

sharing.title: Service providers and transfers
sharing.body: We use external providers for hosting, database services and email delivery: Vercel, Neon and Resend. Signing in with Yandex ID involves Yandex. Data may be processed on servers outside Belarus. We do not publish senders' feedback or sell personal data.

storage.title: Storage and security
storage.body: Data is stored while needed to provide the service and meet applicable obligations. Access is restricted using authentication and technical safeguards. To request deletion of your account or associated data, contact the email address above.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: You may request information about the processing of your data, correction, cessation of processing or deletion where provided by law, and withdraw consent where processing is based on it. Contact georgyrevazashvili@yandex.ru. You may also contact the National Personal Data Protection Center of the Republic of Belarus.

cookies.title: Cookies and analytics
cookies.body: The site uses technical cookies for sign-in and saving preferences. It also uses Yandex Metrica to analyze visits. Processing analytics data and managing consent require separate configuration; this policy does not replace consent controls for analytics cookies.

ForWhat.title: Why is «Back signal» needed
ForWhat.description: It's better to learn about a problem from a client than from an online review.

1.title: To hear a dissatisfied customer
1.description: Give the customer the opportunity to tell you about the problem right away, while they are still with you and the situation can be fixed.

2.title: To give emotions the right outlet
2.description: If the customer is upset or angry, it's important for them to express themselves. It's better to hear from them directly than to learn about the problem from a public review.

3.title: To receive not only complaints
3.description: Customers can share ideas and suggestions. And regular guests often know better than others what can be improved.

4.title: Not to force the customer to adapt
4.description: You don't need your messenger, account or email. Just open the QR code and write.

5.title: To receive honest feedback
5.description: Without registration and the need to disclose their contacts, customers can more easily say what they really think.

6.title: To fix problems earlier
6.description: The message is sent directly to the responsible person — without publication on third-party platforms.

HowItWorks.title: How «Back signal» works
HowItWorks.description: Three simple steps — and you start receiving feedback from your customers.

1.label: Place the QR code
1.title: Place the QR code in a convenient location for the customer
1.description: On the table, counter, receipt, packaging, door or any other place where the customer will see it.
1.imageAlt: Sign with QR code on the table

2.label: Customer leaves feedback
2.title: Customer scans the QR code and leaves feedback
2.description: Customer opens a simple form in the browser, without registration, apps or sharing contact information.
2.imageAlt: Feedback form on the phone screen

3.label: Receive the signal
3.title: You receive a notification
3.description: The message arrives immediately in your personal cabinet or on your email. You can quickly learn what the customer liked, what went wrong or what ideas for improvement there are.
3.imageAlt: New messages from customers in the personal cabinet

HowItWorks.decorator: All process in one chain. The signal returns back to your business, helping you to get more satisfied customers.

5.title: Your business
5.description: You learn their opinion and improve

CTA.title: Start listening to your customers
CTA.description: Create a company page, get a QR code and start collecting feedback today.
CTA.subtitle: No card · Setup in a few minutes

CTAImage.imageAlt: QR code and personal cabinet of the «Back signal» service

1.question: Do customers need to register?
1.answer: No. The customer scans the QR code and immediately goes to the feedback form. They don't need to create an account, install an app, specify their email or use a specific messenger.

2.question: Who will see the feedback?
2.answer: The message is not published on the website and does not affect public ratings. Feedback is sent directly to your business and is available in your personal cabinet.

3.question: Where can I place the QR code?
3.answer: Anywhere convenient for customers to see and scan it: on the table, counter, receipt, packaging, door or any other place. You can also share a regular link to the form.

4.question: For which businesses is «Back signal» suitable?
4.answer: For any business that works with customers: cafes and restaurants, stores, service industries, delivery, online stores, marketplaces and other B2C directions.
